AG and albumin-corrected AG added for metabolic acidosis.
HAGMA delta-gap/corrected-HCO3 and delta-ratio logic added: <1 NAGMA direction; 1-2 uncomplicated HAGMA direction; >2 metabolic-alkalosis/pre-existing-high-HCO3 direction.
